question: Which of the following substances is NOT a product of the reaction catalyzed by heme oxygenase ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Heme -> Heme oxygenase -> Biliverdin -> 95% CHAIN: Heme -> Heme oxygenase -> Fe2+ -> 95% CHAIN: Heme -> Heme oxygenase -> CO -> 5% CHAIN: Heme -> Heme oxygenase -> CO2 -> 95%
analysis: Heme oxygenase catalyzes the conversion of heme into biliverdin, Fe2+, and carbon monoxide (CO). Carbon dioxide (CO2) is not a product of this reaction.
